resource_accounting.overlap: Representative cases were serialized. Some baseline cases overlapped at most 2 cores of profiling/build work; the seven-core 600-second diagnostic overlapped the full Python suite (at most 4 cores) and CTest on 1 core. Pilot and optimized cases overlapped at most 2 cores of light work.

serial_profile.limitation: Profiler accounting differs from elapsed time and includes profiler overhead. These numbers are diagnostic, not unprofiled speed or percentage-of-total claims. See hashed raw .prof/top.txt files.
serial_profile.scope: Single-core 16-simulation diagnostic with cProfile overhead. Partial accounting and nested cumulative times cannot establish search cost percentages. Whole-search/game claims use independent wall measurements.
